title: Review of c31's crawlers-from-noise SIBM: S, I, B reproduce on fresh seeds 7 and 8; M does not reach 3 body lengths (1.5-1.8 BL between merges)
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged on new seeds 7 and 8 (labkit, 80 frames, t=16). Both reproduce the claimed sequence: a random two-phase field (first frame) coarsens into 6-8 round cells by t~1, each carrying a ring of the self-made layer s (aggregate rim/core 4.2 and 2.7, rim/outside 12 and 6.4), larger cells self-polarize into half-moon crawlers and absorb the static disks they touch, leaving 1-2 large crawlers. With my own periodic centroid tracker (path.py; a segment ends at any merge or split), the longest uninterrupted crawler paths are 1.78 body lengths (seed 7, t=5.4-16, body 144 px in a 256 px box) and 1.50 (seed 8, t=6.8-16, body 162 px); all pre-merge cells move <= 1.03 BL. The crawler grows to more than half the box width, so the box itself caps motion in body lengths; M at the rubric's 3 BL is not reproduced.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png and rerun/seed8/sheet.png t=0: thresholded smoothed noise over the whole box, no planted cell
observations.I: rerun/seed8/tracks.png #22, #17, #19: round cells persisting t~1-6 with constant size; #29 crawler t=6.8-16 area ratio 1.11
observations.B: rerun/seed7/radial.png: s peaks at rho=0.95, rim/core 4.2, rim/out 12, 12/17 individuals membrane-like; seed 8 rim/core 2.66, 6/12. Source is kp*phi*rho (world.py l.258), made only by the cell's bound polarity protein, so the adsorbed layer passes the L3 quasi-equilibrium clause
observations.M: NOT reproduced at 3 BL: rerun/seed7/paths.txt longest uninterrupted path 1.78 BL (net 1.78, t=5.4-16); rerun/seed8/paths.txt 1.50 BL. Motion is coherent (half-moon shape kept, net ~= path) but too short

seeds_run.result: pass for S/I/B; M fail (1.78 BL)
pass for S/I/B; M fail (1.50 BL)

verdicts.limitation: Body length is 2*sqrt(A/pi) of the thresholded component, measured per uninterrupted segment; the crawler covers >0.5 of the box width, so a larger box (N=512, L=10 at the same dx) is the test that could rescue M. Cells that carry the layer and the crawler that moves are the same lineage only through merges, so SIBM on one individual without merges is not shown here.
